abstract: A laparoscopic approach to giant ovarian cysts in girls, when the cyst's size exceeds the umbilicus, may be difficult regarding the risk of cyst rupture and limited working space. We present a series of three 12-year-old girls with giant ovarian cysts treated by percutaneous drainage under ultrasonographic guidance followed by laparoscopic resection. Clinical, laboratory and radiological diagnosis showed no signs of malignancy. After induction of general endotracheal anaesthesia, under ultrasonographic guidance, a 10 F vesicostomy catheter was placed into the cyst. Two to 4 l of serous (in one case mucinous) fluid were drained from the cyst. During laparoscopy, the abdominal cavity was inspected by the scope and no signs of malignancy were found. The laparoscopic procedure was completed with excision of the cyst and keeping some ovarian tissue in all cases. No intraoperative complications were observed. The mean operation time was 73 min. Pathological examination revealed a mature cystic teratoma in two cases and mucinous cystadenoma in one. The postoperative recovery was uneventful in all girls and they were discharged home on postoperative day 2-4 with minimal pain. The ultrasound scans and tumour markers were normal on follow-up after 3 and 6 months. Laparoscopic excision of giant ovarian cysts after ultrasound-guided drainage seems to be a safe and applicable treatment modality in pre-menarchal girls with a normal tumour marker profile and benign features of the cyst, excluding the possibility of malignancy.
abstract_ja: 思春期前の女児における巨大卵巣嚢腫に対する腹腔鏡手術は、嚢腫径が臍を超える場合、嚢腫破裂のリスクや作業スペースの制限から困難となりうる。本報告では、12歳の女児3例の巨大卵巣嚢腫について、超音波ガイド下経皮的ドレナージの後に腹腔鏡下切除を行った症例を提示する。臨床、検査、画像による診断では悪性所見はなかった。全身麻酔導入後、超音波ガイド下に10Fの膀胱瘻用カテーテルを嚢腫内に留置した。2〜4Lの漿液性(1例は粘液性)の液体を排液した。腹腔鏡検査では腹腔内を観察し、悪性所見は認められなかった。腹腔鏡手術は、嚢腫の切除と、全例で卵巣組織の一部を温存して完了した。術中合併症はみられなかった。平均手術時間は73分であった。病理組織学的検査では、2例は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫、1例は粘液性嚢胞腺腫であった。全例で術後経過は順調で、術後2〜4日目に軽度の疼痛のみで退院した。術後3か月および6か月のフォローアップ時の超音波検査および腫瘍マーカーは正常であった。超音波ガイド下ドレナージ後の腹腔鏡下巨大卵巣嚢腫切除は、腫瘍マーカーが正常で嚢腫が良性の所見を示す初経前女児において、悪性腫瘍を除外したうえで、安全で適用可能な治療法と考えられる。
